mode_rationale: At least one Core Value has active Drift.

previous_evidence.excerpt: Didi called from Bangalore. She's remodelling her flat and asked if I wanted her old furniture shipped to Lucknow. Said no thanks, my room barely fits what I already have. Realized after I hung up that we didn't talk about...

current_evidence.excerpt: Finished compiling the mid-term attendance data. Our school's retention rate is up from last year, which the principal seemed happy about. Stayed back to help the peon uncle fix a broken desk in my classroom.
But I kept quiet because Sharma sir is senior and it was the end of a long day and I didn't have the energy to start something.
But today I was tired and the Hazratganj shop was right there and I just wanted to get it done fast. So I spent probably twice as much at a chain store when I could have waited one more day...
